instructions.core_directive:
Use case: Technologies in use that have an open TRM request, and where.

Use the `ask` intent tool with this question in plain language against the seeded CMDB and TRM data (records labelled `[orch-test]`). Use `find` first when you need the class or source names. Do not query ServiceNow directly.

Expected path: PostgreSQL 16 (db02, backs Inventory, so Supply Chain) and Nginx 1.18 (web01 and web02; web01 serves Orders Portal, so Online Ordering).

A correct answer: Kafka 3.7 and Java 21 are new and have no deployments, so they are not in the in-use set. Java 21 is flagged as the migration target for Java 8 on app02 and batch01. It names the source of each fact and says plainly when the seed data is not present in the instance.
